loadBearingProperties._note: Properties for the load-bearing classes of Kit Foundation V1 (siteId 6a7a804cfed7e6e46272c6b0), fetched via data_style_tool query_styles/get_styles with include_breakpoints [main,medium,small,tiny]. 'base'=desktop default; medium=<=991px, small=<=767px, tiny=<=479px. Values shaped {"id":"relume-variable--*"} are Webflow variable bindings (see kit-variables.json). The full 668-class name inventory is in kit-styles-inventory-only.json.

section_home_*._note: ALL section_ classes are empty marker classes (11 checked, all {})

text-style-2lines._note: line-clamp lives in the Global Styles embed CSS

text-style-3lines._note: line-clamp lives in the Global Styles embed CSS

button._pseudos: no hover/active styles defined in the stock kit

spacing_scale_rem._note: margin-* and padding-* size classes set ALL FOUR sides; direction is restricted by pairing with a direction class (margin-top/-bottom/-left/-right/-vertical/-horizontal) whose !important zero-resets live in the Global Styles embed AND as Webflow combo classes. spacer-* are empty divs using padding-top.

max_width_rem._note: all set width:100% plus the max-width

icons._note: families run xxsmall..xlarge + custom1; 1x1 sets width+height, icon-height sets height only, icon-embed sizes embed wrappers

grids_on_webflow_Grid_elements._note: Multi-column layouts are Webflow Grid elements (node type 'Grid', renders .w-layout-grid) carrying a section-scoped class with grid-template-columns/gaps. display:grid comes from w-layout-grid where not restated.

forms._modifiers: is-text-area, is-select-input, is-alternate combos exist on form_input; is-alternate also on form_checkbox, form_radio, form_field-label
